title: Ashbury Rewards Points Commerce Terms: Base of the Purchase Allowance
content:
**1. Base of the allowance.** The Ashbury Rewards purchase allowance of an account — the most points it may buy in the twelve months before the handling date — rests on a base. The base of the purchase allowance depends on the age of the account and on the tier: an account enrolled for fewer than twenty-four whole calendar months by the handling date takes as base the points earned from stays in the twelve months; an account enrolled for twenty-four or more whole months whose member holds Ashbury Rewards Member, Silver Elite or Gold Elite takes as base the points earned from stays in the twelve months plus ten thousand points. Accounts enrolled for twenty-four or more whole months at Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite carry no different base under these terms. The purchase allowance built on this base is never more than the points purchase annual cap of the tier.

**2. Points earned from stays.** The points earned from stays in the twelve months before the handling date are the base points and elite bonus points and the welcome points posted in those months less the stay credit reversals posted in those months.

**3. Periods.** The twelve months before the handling date are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date. The age of the account is counted in whole calendar months from the enrolment date to the handling date.

| Whole months enrolled | Tier | Base of the purchase allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Fewer than 24 | any | Points earned from stays in the twelve months |
| 24 or more | Member, Silver Elite or Gold Elite | Points earned from stays in the twelve months plus 10000 |
| 24 or more | Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | No different base under these terms |

## Worked figures (hypothetical accounts)

| Account | Base points and elite bonus in the window | Welcome points in the window | Stay credit reversals in the window | Points earned from stays | Base |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Enrolled 14 months, Platinum Elite | 21300 | 2000 | 1500 | 21800 | 21800 |
| Enrolled 30 months, Silver Elite | 8400 | 0 | 0 | 8400 | 18400 |
| Enrolled 23 months, Gold Elite | 12000 | 500 | 0 | 12500 | 12500 |
